Weather Alert: Heavy Rain and High Winds Forecast for 22 Indian States

The India Meteorological Department (IMD) has issued alerts for heavy rainfall and strong winds across 22 states, with warnings in effect for September 15. Some regions are expected to experience downpours within a nine-hour period, accompanied by winds gusting up to 80 kilometers per hour. In Gujarat, Ahmedabad has already seen significant rainfall, with an average of 3 inches in 8 hours causing waterlogging on several roads and 3 feet of water in areas like Manekbaug. The IMD has issued red and orange alerts for multiple districts in Gujarat, indicating a high risk of severe weather. The forecast suggests a continuation of these conditions, impacting daily life in affected areas.
